findings.description: Actual E2 ExitConstraints are placed in TradeIntent, but caller RiskProposal required_stop_level/required_target_level are passed unchanged to E5 without correspondence checks. The existing E5 proposal validator does not compare them with intent geometry, and ApprovedTradePlan takes its protection levels from RiskDecision/proposal. A typed proposal can therefore override the actual E2 stop/target and still reach guarded POST.
findings.minimal_fix: Require exact correspondence of explicit proposal stop/target with the actual resolved E2 constraints before E5 evaluation, or derive those exact geometry fields within the trusted composition and reject conflicting inputs. Preserve explicit sizing/context/cost vectors and unchanged existing E5 math/policy.
findings.fault_injection_plan: Reuse actual registered E2 fixture. Change only proposal required_stop_level/required_target_level to different finite positive values within the unchanged risk policy. The owner must refuse before decision/canonical publication/claim/POST; do not patch E2/E5 outputs.

findings.description: Intrinsic persisted E2 links/clocks are incomplete: signal content hash/evaluated_at, intent signal_id/generated_at/market boundary and ExitRequest direction/observed_at/market boundary are not bound to the original stored subject/boundary and one another. Changing only a genuine emitted TradeIntent.generated_at to a future UTC value while retaining its intent_id/effects currently satisfies the decoder, yielding false approved E2 history.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate exact original signal subject/content/boundary and cross-link ExitRequest/TradeIntent direction, symbol, signal ID, market reference and original clocks. Rebuild the exact intent through the existing TradeIntent builder plus resolved existing ExitRequest constraints and compare where possible; no E1-history replay, separate risk math or new permission is required.
findings.fault_injection_plan: Intercept one actual owner-produced ProductEntryObservation just before staging. Alter only intent.generated_at, signal content/evaluation clock, or exit/intent market binding and reserialize evidence. Require typed refusal without canonical effects/claim/provider calls. This is a corrupted internal fact check, not treating the observation dataclass as a public permission API.

supported_static_conclusions: EntryOwner restricts this first slice to actual TradingService with a bound process and FIXTURE/FAKE_PROVIDER_VERIFICATION. It obtains actual current E6/E7 policy/strategy, checks same namespace/content/hash/generation and reconstructs caller SelectedRiskPolicy rather than trusting declared fields.

Operational AsOfBundle is rebuilt with recorded_received_at; source cutoff/boundary cannot exceed owner time. Length-framed streaming commitment includes canonical E1 availability/source fields and explicit policy/context/proposal without duplicating full candle history in SQLite.

Actual existing E2 and E5 functions are called; first E5 time is sampled after E2/input work. Immutable decision is staged before canonical risk/plan, request/claim or POST. No healthy/balance/sizing defaults or financial profile activation are introduced.

PREPARED unclaimed replay requires the same still-current local issuer object; lost original local preparation blocks without adoption or retranslation.

Canonical entry publication and receipt writers are sequential, without nested dispatch/canonical write transactions. The atomic migration marker is first; decision PK and unique decision-ID REPLACE guards plus immutable publication guards are present.
